    • buildStation

      public CreateStationController.Error buildStation(String typeStr, Map map, Scenario scenario, int x, int y, Station.Orientation orientation, Budget budget)
      Method responsible to build a station on the given map.
      Parameters:
      typeStr - the type of station to be built
      map - the map where the station will be built
      scenario - the scenario where the station will be built
      x - the x-coordinate of the station's center
      y - the y-coordinate of the station's center
      orientation - the station's orientation
      budget - the budget the player has on this map and scenario
      Returns:
      Error#OK if valid;Error#INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS if the player doesn't have enough budget; Error#INVALID_COORDINATES if the player tries to place the station or its area outside the map;Error#OVERBUILD if the player tries to build the station in the same position as another structure; Error#INVALID_TYPE if the station isn't from a valid type;

    • buildStation

      public CreateStationController.Error buildStation(String typeStr, Map map, Scenario scenario, int x, int y, Station.Orientation orientation, Budget budget, int cost)
      Method responsible to try to build a station on the given map (used to upgrade the station).
      Parameters:
      typeStr - the type of station to be built
      map - the map where the station will be built
      scenario - the scenario where the station will be built
      x - the x-coordinate of the station's center
      y - the y-coordinate of the station's center
      orientation - the station's orientation
      budget - the players budget on thsi map and scenario
      cost - the cost of the upgrade
      Returns:
      Error#OK if valid;Error#INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS if the player doesn't have enough budget; Error#INVALID_COORDINATES if the player tries to place the station or its area outside the map;Error#OVERBUILD if the player tries to build the station in the same position as another structure; Error#INVALID_TYPE if the station isn't from a valid type;
